_game: ViZDoom: Defend the Center (Doom action-shooter; COOM engine)
_note: pip install vizdoom. Doom scenario via ViZDoom's gymnasium envs. Try other Vizdoom*-v1 ids (DeadlyCorridor, HealthGathering, TakeCover, Deathmatch, ...).
_keys_note: Action indices are scenario-specific. For VizdoomDefendCenter-v1 the Discrete(4) map is 0=noop, 1=ATTACK, 2=TURN_RIGHT, 3=TURN_LEFT (verify with env.unwrapped.button_map). 'keys' below hardcodes the mapping; 'controls_screen' hardcodes exactly what the pre-game screen shows.
